name: All Eight Hazards Converge

npcs.name: Rico Dela Cruz
dialogue: All eight hazard warnings are active around Mount Talon. This route is our last chance.
Take cover during shaking; avoid floodwater, smoke, ash, and unstable slopes.
after_dialogue: The team is together. We will follow the safest route and keep listening for updates.

choice.prompt: Water is nearing the control level. What should be prioritized?

options.text: Move personnel and preserve emergency power
options.result: Personnel and emergency support remain protected.
options.consequence: You protected people and emergency power.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Recover extra equipment from the lower floor
options.result: The lower floor may flood and contain electrical hazards.
options.consequence: You risked personnel for extra equipment.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Dr. Mira Santos
dialogue: I helped the harbor and plains teams, but floodwater, smoke, ash, and debris now block this road.
I hurt my leg. Bring the radio so I can call for help, then carry me to the control shelter.
after_dialogue: The response team is on the radio. Please carry me away from the flood channel.
rescue_dialogue: I cannot walk safely with my injured leg. Bring the emergency radio, then carry me to inland high ground.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. Please carry me to inland high ground.
npcs.rescue_hint: Collect the emergency radio, then speak with Dr. Mira Santos again.

npcs.name: Aling Rosa
dialogue: I have seen neighbors help one another at every shelter on this island.
Please bring first aid. We still have families to guide away from the hazards.
after_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you. Let's keep the families together and move uphill.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need first-aid kit. Please bring it, then help me get to inland high ground.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to inland high ground now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find first-aid kit, then speak with Aling Rosa again.

quests.title: Secure drinking water for the response team
Find first aid for injured personnel
Help Dr. Mira Santos reach the evacuation route
Help Aling Rosa reach the evacuation route
Reach the control facility evacuation route

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_pilar: Find Dr. Mira Santos and give her the radio so she can call the response team.
quests.community: Find Rico Dela Cruz and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach the marked inland safe zone.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Never walk or drive through floodwater; depth and current can be hard to judge.
Move to higher ground and follow local evacuation instructions.
Keep emergency supplies and a family communication plan ready.

quiz.question: Floodwater covers your planned route. What should you do?
options: Turn around and use a safe route directed by local authorities
Walk through if it looks shallow
Follow a vehicle through the water
quiz.explanation: Floodwater depth and current are difficult to judge. Never walk or drive through it.

briefing: The World Engine activates a typhoon defense sequence, then severe flooding threatens lower facility levels. Keep personnel away from exposed structures and floodwater near electrical equipment. Protect essential emergency systems, choose viable evacuation routes, and reach the central controls.
story_clue: Every earlier rescue, resource, record, and decision can now affect the shutdown.
